findings.checklist_item: Restate the no-tool/no-prefill premise precisely: the NEW 5.5 ids route PromptedOutput because they are unmapped in _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES and inherit the family default (not because all Claude ids do — Sonnet 4.6 has native_structured_output=True).
evidence: Plan: 'capabilities._REBAR_OVERRIDES (...) pins Claude to native_structured_output=False (...) so Claude always takes PromptedOutput (no tool, no prefill)'

capabilities.py:227-230 'claude-sonnet-4-6': {'native_structured_output': True, ...} and :242-245 'us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6': native_structured_output True — exact-id overrides applied AFTER the family default (merge at :396-406)
Operative conclusion remains sound: 5.5 ids are absent from _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES so they inherit the family False and route PromptedOutput
findings.finding: The riskiest-assumption justification states Claude 'always takes PromptedOutput (no tool, no prefill)', but _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES sets native_structured_output=True for claude-sonnet-4-6 / us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, so today's VERIFIER_DEFAULT_MODEL (Sonnet 4.6) takes NativeOutput. The conclusion holds for the new 5.5 ids only because they are UNMAPPED and inherit the family default False — the plan should state the premise precisely (unmapped 5.5 ids inherit PromptedOutput) rather than as a universal Claude fact.
scenarios: A reviewer or implementer takes the 'Claude always' wording literally and assumes Sonnet 4.6's verify path also uses PromptedOutput, mis-modeling the before/after no-tool invariant on the standard slot.
findings.suggested_fix: Reword to: 'the 5.5 ids are unmapped in _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES, so they inherit the Claude family default native_structured_output=False and take PromptedOutput (no tool, no prefill)'.
